_comment: Which verbatim licence text backs which provenance source.
This file is the machine-readable half of LICENSES.md, and it exists so that
'we have the licence' is a checkable claim rather than a sentence in a
document nobody re-reads. test/edrdg.test.ts checks it three ways: every file
listed here exists and hashes to the digest recorded here; every path and
digest recorded here appears verbatim in LICENSES.md; and every provenance
source whose licence is not the project's own pending-OD-09 placeholder has an
entry here. The negative half matters more than the positive: a source that
claims a third-party licence with no text on disk fails the suite, which is
what stops the next import from shipping data whose licence was written from
'requiresOnScreenAttribution' records the EDRDG condition that an attribution
buried in a file does not satisfy: §3 of the EDRDG licence statement demands
acknowledgement on the screen that displays words from the files. The seed's
SEED_ENTRY_DISCLOSURE is what carries it, and the tests assert that.
